criteria.evidence: Candidate source wires local fixture events through LocalAlpacaMarketTransport's in-memory socket into the production AlpacaMarketStream handshake, decoder, and MarketStateAccumulator. Local API observations use stream.marketStates(); candidate-bound focused integration evidence passes. Independent reviewer confirms frame and accumulator path.

The local socket factory validates the configured Alpaca stock stream URL and codec headers, then returns an EventEmitter-backed in-memory socket; it never constructs a WebSocket client. Local startup uses fixed simulation-only credentials and the test harness requires credential-free loopback configuration. Security review found no external network route or credential lookup. Candidate-bound focused suite and security review pass.

Fixture replay has bounded steps, a virtual clock, reset controls, and checked replay-prefix accumulator restoration preserving normalized state. Candidate-bound Docker restart check adapter-docker-restart-3 passes and reports credentialFree=true, PAPER mode, virtual-time rewind, and restoration of virtual_time, replay_cursor, normalized_market, and normalized_account.

Candidate-bound focused integration evidence exercises network, rate-limit, and broker stream failure injection, sanitized health/log/trace observations, deterministic retry scheduling, and bounded recovery. Full verifier suite passes. Security review independently checked bounded failure controls and sanitized observations.

Candidate-bound focused evidence covers JSON and MessagePack frame handling, malformed/duplicate/out-of-order rejection, replay state and recovery; the in-memory socket implementation provides evidence no real WebSocket was created. Full offline suite reports 7 files and 74 tests passed.

The frozen candidate classifies as critical and requires review, security-review, verifier, and evaluation lanes. Candidate-bound review, security-review, verifier, and this evaluation record bind the same task bundle and candidate with PASS. Verifier also records successful full offline tests, TypeScript noEmit, and the local Docker restart check.
